title: Ines and the Summer
author: Astrid Eastwick
blurb: Ines Fairweather, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
